summary: I build cloud-native platforms from the ground up, combining hands-on engineering, distributed systems architecture, and practical AI-assisted developer workflows.

highlights.label: Users the BRP system can handle

experience.description: Independently designed and implemented the foundation for an internal developer platform within my first month at BRP Systems, establishing the architecture for SaaS operations and AI-assisted development. The system can handle over 3 million users, meeting a business requirement.
metrics: Platform Foundation: Independently designed and implemented an internal developer platform foundation within my first month, covering SaaS operations and deployment practices on Google Cloud Platform.
Scale & Migration: Built a system capable of handling over 3 million users, meeting a business requirement and supporting the architecture for large-scale migration.
Reliability & Security: Designed for high availability, workload separation, zero trust, and observability.
AI Developer Workflows: Responsible for direction, tools, and workflows for AI-assisted product development.
Reliable Data Flows: Applied Bento, change data capture (CDC), outbox/inbox patterns, idempotency, retries, and replay to distributed data flows.

experience.description: Joined Saab as a Platform Specialist to design and implement a full-scale Azure cloud platform with observability.
metrics: Distributed Systems: Building a centralized Azure data hub that exposes core services and APIs for master data distribution across Saab systems.
Observability: Implementing an observability stack with Azure Application Insights and Grafana-stack to monitor services, APIs, and infrastructure across the platform.
Scalability & Reliability: Developing a central MySQL database for the platform hub, supporting high-volume data ingestion via migration scripts and API-driven, scalable, and reliable 24/7 access.

experience.description: Joined the world’s largest underground iron-ore mine to improve IT operations and develop new secure solutions.
metrics: Cloud-Native & SaaS: Designing cloud-native solutions and integrations at LKAB using containerization and Kubernetes with SaaS-style deployment and operations.

Event-Driven Systems: Designing event-driven systems at LKAB using RabbitMQ to build real-time, asynchronous data pipelines that decouple services, support scalable integration, and enable future AI-driven workflows.
System Integration: Led modernization across a scope of 200+ BizTalk and custom integrations, using Azure Integration Services to establish a scalable, cloud-native integration platform.

AI & Agents Integration: Integrated AI-driven prompts and AI agents into LKAB’s integration workflows, enhancing development speed and code quality while building and scaling the AIS integration platform.
API-Driven Platforms: Managed Azure API Management to centralize API-driven platforms and standardize secure access across hundreds of services.

experience.description: Engaged by CGI to design and improve IT applications for Swedish government agencies, enhancing performance, security, and long-term maintainability.
metrics: Kubernetes & Containers: Led Kubernetes adoption on OpenShift, guiding the team in building and deploying cloud-native containerized microservices with end-to-end CI/CD for fast delivery of microservices.
Platform Modernization: Modernized legacy Java services by migrating them to OpenShift with Quarkus, improving startup time, scalability, and resource efficiency for mission-critical systems.

Security-First Design: Designed UX and frontend interactions with strict access controls and guardrails, ensuring that caseworkers cannot perform unauthorized actions or access data beyond their permissions.

DevOps & CI/CD: Implemented a full DevOps pipeline where every service—from new to migrated—was built, tested, and deployed via CI/CD, with automated vulnerability checks, test verification, and secure handling of secrets and configuration.

experience.description: During my parental leave and freelance work, I decided to volunteer at the preschool my children attend.
metrics: Communication Skills: Facilitated open communication among staff members to resolve long-standing conflicts in a school environment, fostering collaboration, trust, and a more supportive workplace culture.
Project Planning: Planned, executed, and completed a streamlined school closure process—balancing operational needs with stakeholder communication to ensure a smooth transition.
Problem Solving: Handled high-value severance packages and successfully supported several employees in securing new roles during a challenging transition.

experience.description: Developed full-stack software solutions at Linköping University to support physical vapor deposition (PVD) experiments and molecular dynamics simulations.
metrics: Solution Design: Led the solution design for a system that performed advanced simulations of metals under extreme heat, using Python, MongoDB, and custom frontend components.
Agile & Product Focus: Implemented and evolved Agile practices to improve delivery pace, ownership, and software quality through short iterations, retrospectives, and close collaboration.
Technical Leadership: Provided technical leadership by guiding team members in the setup and development of C++, Python, and many other languages across multiple projects such as PVD experiments.
Full-Stack Development: Developed frontend and backend services to operate, calculate, and manage molecular dynamics simulations, storing and querying data in NoSQL databases.

education: Bachelor’s Degree, Linköping University | Linköping, Sweden
M.Sc. in Engineering Physics and Electrical Engineering (incomplete), Linköping University
